description: LiteLLM Proxy - a unified API gateway for 100+ LLMs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and local models. Exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on port 4000.
notes:
Configured to route all requests to local Ollama (qwen2.5-coder:7b-32k) via the WSL2 host at 172.22.48.1:11434.

Anthropics fallback: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment to enable.

Proxy API key: sk-local
Proxy port: 4000 (inside container)
Set Kasm Proxy Port to 4000 for API access.

Temporary working Kasm fallback: Chrome workspace while LiteLLM service image is run separately or rebuilt on a Kasm base.
